title: Independent Learning Verification, Generation Debugging & Controlled Recovery

scientific_findings.memorization_vs_generalization: Disproved that narrow one-example overfit demonstrates reasoning. The model trained on '2 + 3 = 5' produces '5' with 99.91% probability on unseen '3 + 4 = ?'. Single-example SFT merely conditioned the model to map the ChatML turn to '5'.
scientific_findings.loss_reduction_vs_exact_match: In a 32-example arithmetic pilot, token loss dropped from ~7.00 to 0.38 across train, validation, and held-out benchmark splits with 100% EOS emission, yet exact match remained 0.0% due to persistent bias towards table syntax numbers (|277).
scientific_findings.table_attractor_investigation: Confirmed that the 10,000-step pretraining Wikipedia table attractor dominates greedy generation unless extensive multi-turn training data is provided.
